project: Spendenvideo – Kuran Öğretme Hizmeti (Koranunterricht für Kinder in Afrika)
purpose: Short donation appeal video for a mosque community (Turkish-German), to be shared via WhatsApp/Instagram. Goal: donations for Quran teachers (Hodschas/hocalar) in Africa who receive no state support and depend entirely on donations.
format: 9:16 vertical, 1080x1920, ~70 seconds. Most viewers watch on a phone, often muted → on-screen text carries the message.

audience_and_voice.de: German, informal 'du' (warm, community tone). Spelling: 'Koran', 'Hodscha/Hodschas', 'Spende'. No exclamation-mark overload.
audience_and_voice.tr: Turkish, polite plural 'siz' (e.g. 'Bağışınızla…'). Correct diacritics (İ ı ğ ş ç ö ü) are mandatory. Spelling: Kur'an, Kur'an-ı Kerim, hoca/hocalar, sadaka-i cariye. Natural, native-level Turkish as used by Turkish communities in Germany.

allowed_facts: The children sit on mats on the ground – in a sandy courtyard against a brick wall, or in a simple room with yellow walls. No desks, no benches.
They learn and write on wooden tablets (Arabic: lawh; Turkish: levha/tahta) – visible in the photos.
The video clips show two boys reciting the Quran from memory / from a tablet.
The teachers (Hodschas / hocalar) receive NO salary or support from the state or anyone else.
The teachers and their lessons depend entirely on donations.
Location: Chad (TR: Çad), city of Abéché (TR: Abeşe). The responsible teacher is Cihat Göçer, contact +90 534 234 84 67 (WhatsApp). These may appear in the title subtitle and on the CTA card.
Hadith (Sahih al-Bukhari 5027): 'The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.' Arabic: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ – may be quoted with source '(Buhârî)'.
Concept of sadaqa jariya (ongoing charity) may be referenced in connection with teaching the Quran (knowledge that benefits).
forbidden: No invented numbers (number of children, teachers, costs, meals, years).
No claims about what exactly the money buys (books, food, water, salaries) unless phrased generally, e.g. 'unterstützt die Hodschas und ihren Unterricht'.
No pity framing ('arme Kinder', 'hungernde Kinder'), no guilt-tripping. Dignity first: the children are shown smiling, proud, learning.
Do not change the fixed texts marked fixed=true.
No names of children. Payment details are not available yet – the CTA shows a placeholder for them.

typography_limits.big: max 2 lines, max 24 characters per line (large headline on a phone screen)
typography_limits.medium: max 3 lines, max 30 characters per line
typography_limits.small: max 2 lines, max 40 characters per line
typography_limits.note: Use \n for a deliberate line break. Writers must count characters; the renderer will NOT wrap gracefully if limits are exceeded.

slots.media: CLIP B (7 s): boy in white cap holding a large wooden tablet covered in handwritten Quran verses, reciting out loud, red-brick wall behind him. Natural sound of his recitation is heard. Arabic Bismillah (fixed) appears at the top.
slots.purpose: Hook. One short, concrete line that makes the viewer keep watching. Should relate to what they see/hear (a child reciting from a wooden tablet).

slots.note: Small all-caps label above the title. Fixed campaign name (user's wording in DE version kept as the Turkish campaign name).

slots.media: PHOTO (7 s): slow horizontal pan across a sandy courtyard where ~30 boys and young men in white robes and caps sit on mats along a brick wall, some holding Quran copies/tablets; dozens of sandals in the sand in front of them.
slots.purpose: Title of the video. DE e.g. 'Koranunterricht für Kinder in Afrika' (adapt if better), TR equivalent.
One-line subtitle under the title, e.g. 'Ein Spendenaufruf unserer Gemeinde' – but do NOT assume a mosque name. Keep generic.

slots.media: PHOTO (5 s): two teenage boys hold up their wooden tablets – one shows the Arabic alphabet with vowel marks, the other full handwritten verses. Yellow wall behind.
slots.purpose: Observation about how they learn: wooden tablets instead of notebooks. Visible fact, told with respect (not pity).

slots.media: PHOTO PAIR (4.5 s + 4.5 s): first a row of boys in white shirts looking curiously into the camera; then a small boy in a turquoise shirt and white cap, shyly covering his smile with his hand. Text only over the first photo.
slots.purpose: Line about the children themselves: their eagerness, that they come every day to learn the Quran. No numbers.

slots.media: PHOTO (5 s): a smiling boy in a white cap and white robe next to a wooden tablet with Arabic letters; other boys behind him.
slots.purpose: The teachers (Hodschas) receive no salary, nothing from the state.

slots.media: PHOTO (5 s): a very small boy in a white-blue cap and brown robe sits cross-legged alone on a mat in a sandy courtyard, brick wall behind, a few Quran books beside him.
slots.purpose: They depend entirely on donations – the lessons exist only because people give.

slots.media: CLIP A (8 s): a small boy in a white cap and brown robe sits on a mat and recites the Quran from memory, smiling, fiddling with something in his hands. Natural sound of his recitation.
slots.purpose: What the viewer's donation does, phrased generally: it keeps this lesson alive / lets this child keep learning. The emotional peak.

slots.media: PHOTO (6 s): a laughing boy in a red shirt holds up his wooden tablet with handwritten verses of Surah al-Fatiha.
slots.purpose: Translation of the hadith (Bukhari 5027). DE: 'Der Beste unter euch ist, wer den Koran lernt und ihn lehrt.' TR: 'Sizin en hayırlınız, Kur'an'ı öğrenen ve öğretendir.' – writers may polish wording but must stay faithful. Put the source in slot s08_source.
Source line for the hadith, e.g. '— Hadith, Buhârî' (DE) / '— Hadis-i Şerif, Buhârî' (TR).

slots.media: PHOTO PAIR (4.5 s + 4.5 s): two close-ups of boys laughing warmly into the camera, friends leaning on each other. Text over the first photo.
slots.purpose: Sadaqa jariya thought: a donation whose reward continues as long as the children recite / teach what they learned.

slots.media: CTA CARD (10 s): dark-green panel over a blurred photo. Shows heading, then the donation details.
slots.purpose: Call to action heading, e.g. 'Jetzt spenden' / 'Şimdi bağış yapın'.

Return the FOUR field labels joined with ' | ' in this order: organisation, IBAN, payment reference, contact. DE e.g. 'Organisation | IBAN | Verwendungszweck | Kontakt', TR e.g. 'Kuruluş | IBAN | Açıklama | İletişim'. Values will be placeholders filled in by the user later.
One supporting line under the details, e.g. 'Jeder Betrag zählt.' / 'Her miktar değerlidir.'

slots.media: END (5 s): a small boy in a brown embroidered cap and grey shirt smiles broadly into the camera.
slots.purpose: Closing blessing. 'Allah razı olsun' is understood by both audiences – DE version may use it with a German line below (s11_sub).
Closing sub-line: a blessing/thank-you and/or 'share this video' – e.g. DE 'Möge Allah es euch vergelten. Teile dieses Video.' TR 'Paylaşarak da destek olabilirsiniz.'

primary_language: Turkish (TR) is the main version; German (DE) is secondary.
